= BITwiki Quality Bar: Guardrails for Content Integrity =

== Purpose ==

The Quality Bar defines guardrails (validation checkpoints) for BITwiki content. Unlike rating systems that reduce quality to a score, guardrails ensure structural integrity without oversimplifying epistemic complexity.

== Core Principle ==

'''Ratings are useless. Guardrails are essential.'''

A rating tells you nothing about why content fails. A guardrail prevents failure modes.

== Quality Guardrails ==

=== Guardrail: Epistemic Markers Required ===

'''Check:''' Every claim has explicit epistemic status.

'''Validation:'''
* Hypothetical claims marked as such
* Emerging claims note preliminary status
* Established claims cite multiple sources
* Verified claims show replication evidence
* Axiomatic claims reference constitutional status

'''Failure Mode:''' Unmarked claims default to "Unverified" and trigger review.

'''SMW:'''
```wiki
[[Has epistemic status::Established]]
[[Has confidence score::0.75]]
[[Has confidence trajectory::established]]
```

=== Guardrail: Provenance Transparency ===

'''Check:''' All sources traceable to origin.

'''Validation:'''
* Primary sources preferred
* Funding sources disclosed
* Methodology documented
* Data available or accessible
* Replication status tracked

'''Failure Mode:''' Opaque sources rejected pending disclosure.

'''SMW:'''
```wiki
[[Has source type::Primary]]
[[Has funding disclosed::true]]
[[Has replication status::Replicated]]
```

=== Guardrail: Logical Coherence ===

'''Check:''' Content internally consistent.

'''Validation:'''
* No contradictions within page
* Definitions used consistently
* Arguments valid (conclusions follow premises)
* Evidence relevant to claims

'''Failure Mode:''' Contradictions flagged for resolution.

=== Guardrail: Structural Completeness ===

'''Check:''' Required fields populated.

'''Validation:'''
* Name/definition present
* Author attributed
* Creation date recorded
* Category assigned
* SMW infobox valid

'''Failure Mode:''' Incomplete pages marked with error category.

=== Guardrail: Transclusion Hygiene ===

'''Check:''' Templates properly isolated.

'''Validation:'''
* <noinclude> tags on documentation
*  tags on transcluded content
* No category leakage
* Parser functions valid

'''Failure Mode:''' Malformed templates trigger validation errors.

== Alternative View: v4.0.0 Simplified Structure ==

The following presents the guardrails in a more compact, principle-driven format:

= Quality Bar =

Ratings are useless. Guardrails are essential.

Traditional systems ask: how good is this? They answer with stars, grades, scores. These answers create illusion of precision while obscuring actual problems.

We ask: does this content fail any critical checks? The answer is binary: pass or fail. The checks are specific, actionable, tied to structural integrity.

== The Guardrails ==

'''Epistemic Markers''': Every claim has explicit status. Hypothetical, Emerging, Established, Verified, Axiomatic.

'''Source Traceability''': Every claim traces to origin. Sources declared. Evidence visible.

'''Value Explicit''': Every artifact declares its generative potential. What does this enable? What does this connect?

'''Structural Integrity''': Ontology consistent. Relationships valid. Machine-readable layer coherent.

Failure on any guardrail is failure. No partial credit. Fix or remove.

[[Has page type::Quality Standard]]
[[Has epistemic tier::Established]]

== Workflow Stages ==

Content progresses through stages, not ratings:

| Stage | Criteria | Exit Condition |
|-------|----------|----------------|
| '''Alpha''' | Initial creation | Passes all guardrails |
| '''Beta''' | Guardrails passed | Community review complete |
| '''Stable''' | Review complete | No changes for 30 days |
| '''Crystallized''' | Stable + replicated | Constitutional status |

'''SMW:'''
```wiki
[[Has workflow stage::Stable]]
[[Last reviewed::2026-02-14]]
```

== Validation Flags ==

Binary flags replace subjective ratings:

| Flag | Meaning | Check |
|------|---------|-------|
| Metadata-Complete | All required fields present | Automated |
| Transclusion-Verified | Template syntax valid | Automated |
| Source-Transparent | Funding disclosed | Manual |
| Logic-Coherent | No contradictions | Automated |
| Epistemic-Marked | Status assigned | Automated |

'''SMW:'''
```wiki
[[Has validation flag::Metadata-Complete]]
[[Has validation flag::Transclusion-Verified]]
```

== Rejection Criteria ==

Content is rejected (not rated down) if:
* Funding undisclosed
* Methodology opaque
* Contradictions unresolved
* Epistemic status missing
* Source unverifiable

== No Scoring ==

BITwiki does not use:
* Numerical ratings
* Star systems
* Letter grades
* Aggregate scores

'''Why:''' Scores obscure failure modes. Guardrails reveal them.

== Quality Checklist ==

Before publishing, verify:
* [ ] Epistemic status assigned
* [ ] Confidence score justified
* [ ] Sources cited with provenance
* [ ] Funding disclosed
* [ ] No contradictions
* [ ] Template syntax valid
* [ ] Categories correct
* [ ] SMW properties valid

== References ==
* BITwiki Epistemic Framework
* BITwiki Source Types
* Template Validation Implementation
